title: Parameter - NoScript
description: The parameter is echoed in a NOSCRIPT tag's CDATA. In this case, no parsing of the payload happens unless </noscript> closes the tag.

Parameter - NoScript

The q parameter is echoed inside a <noscript> block.

Param: ?q=

Note: In modern browsers with JS enabled, content inside <noscript> is hidden unless you close the tag with </noscript>.
objectives: Inject a script payload that executes even when JavaScript is enabled.
Understand how browsers parse content inside NOSCRIPT elements.
hints: When JS is enabled, the browser ignores tags inside NOSCRIPT until it sees </noscript>.
